sloka: शीलेन साम्ना विनयेन सीताम्नयेन न प्राप्स्यसि चेत् नरेन्द्र ।ततः समुत्सादय हेम पुंखैःमहेन्द्र वज्र प्रतिमैः शर ओघैः ॥३-६५-१६॥
transliteration: śīlena sāmnā vinayena sītāmnayena na prāpsyasi cet narendra ।tataḥ samutsādaya hema puṁkhaiḥmahendra vajra pratimaiḥ śara oghaiḥ ॥3-65-16॥

translations.english: O king if you fail to get Sita through appeasement, through humility or diplomacy then you destroy (the three worlds) by your goldtipped stream of arrows comparable to Indra's thunderbolt. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfifth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
